privacy.title: Your data
privacy.p1: To carry out this diagnostic, your answers are sent to our server. Technical information about the processing is recorded.
privacy.p2: If you choose to share your diagnostic with a structure, information about this sharing may also be recorded, depending on the permissions you give.
privacy.p3: On this device, your browser also keeps your answers so that you can continue within 24 hours; after that, they are erased on your next visit. On a shared device, use “{{reset}}” to erase them straight away.
privacy.falc_1: To do the diagnostic, your answers are sent to our server.
privacy.falc_2: We keep technical information about this calculation.
privacy.falc_3: Sharing with a structure is a separate choice.
privacy.falc_4: If you share, we may keep information about this sharing. It depends on what you allow.
privacy.falc_5: Your browser keeps your answers for 24 hours, so you can continue later. Then they are erased on your next visit. On a shared device, click “{{reset}}”.
